notes.1: Baaki teeno me aakriti ka theek aadha bhaag kaala (chhayankit) hai. (B) me aadha bhaag kaala nahi hai.
notes.2: Baaki teen aakritiyan ek hi aakriti ko ghumane se banti hain. (B) ghumane se nahi banti — wo us aakriti ka ulta (darpan) roop hai.
notes.3: Baaki teeno me teer ghadi ki ulti disha me ghoom raha hai. (A) me teer ulti disha me ghoom raha hai.
notes.4: Baaki teeno me andar ke binduon ki sankhya bahari aakriti ki bhujaon ke barabar hai. (A) me ye sankhya barabar nahi hai.
notes.5: (C) hi prashn aakriti jaisi hai. Baaki teeno me koi ek chinh ghuma hua hai ya do chinhon ki jagah badli hui hai — har chinh ki disha dhyan se milaiye.

notes.13: Har agle chitra me aakriti ghadi ki ulti disha me 45° ghoomti hai. Teesre chitra ko utna hi aur ghumane par (D) milta hai.
notes.14: Har agle chitra me usi disha me ek nayi rekha judti hai (1, 2, 3 ...). Chauthe chitra me 4 rekhayen hongi aur nayi rekha pichhli ke theek baad aayegi — (A).
notes.15: Kaala bindu har baar ghadi ki disha me 1 sthan aage badhta hai aur andar ka chhota gola ghadi ki ulti disha me 1 sthan. Dono ko ek-ek kadam aur badhane par (A) milta hai.
notes.16: Aakriti har baar ghadi ki disha me 90° ghoomti hai aur uska rang baari-baari se badalta hai (kaala, safed, kaala ...). Isliye chautha chitra (B) hoga.
notes.17: Pehle jode me bhujaon ki sankhya 1 badh gayi hai aur binduon ki sankhya 1 ghat gayi hai. Teesri aakriti me yahi karne par (A) milta hai.
notes.18: Pehle jode me doosri aakriti pehli ko lekar daayen-baayen palat diya gaya hai (khadi rekha me darpan). Teesri aakriti ke saath wahi karne par (A) milta hai.
